Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (on another windowsill) Perry? What are you doing here? (Perry joins her) Problems with my dad, too? Welcome to the club. (sighs) I've been trying all day to tell him that I've been accepted by OWCA's internship program, but that I can't join if I'm living with OWCA's public enemy number one. (Perry holds up three fingers.) Okay. Number three. Well, I'm just gonna have to tell him and try to convince him to see things my way. Thanks for the chat, Perry. Wish me luck! (She goes inside and Perry waves at her.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Perry? Is that you? Listen Perry, I'd really appreciate it if you didn't let my dad know that I'm here with the son of his sworn enemy. This is going pretty well and I wouldn't want him to spoil it. Can you help me? (Perry nods) Thanks Perry.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay. (closes door) Something's weird here, because I know I only have one of those. Lemme call him and see what's up. Hmm. Voicemail. Odd. Dad, your weird clone-thingies are down here. Could you please just—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Ugh. I should've known Dad would be late. (the inator landed over her and picks her up) Oh, what is this? Curse you, unknown rocket-helmet-transportation thing! (the inator drops her at her house and flies back to D.E.I.) Oh, sweet, I'm home. Never mind, unknown rocket-helmet-transportation thing!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait, Dad. I can do this for you. I can go find this--this Pizzazzium thing and prove to you that I can be responsible. That I can do things on my own. Then you can get me my own car, right?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, Dad. You're basically a nice guy who's pretending to be evil. And, you know, it seems like it's all out of obligation to your backstories, not something that truly comes from your heart.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, the basic. Pretty cool when I was at my mom's and okay when I was at my dad's. Did you know in July, he actually removed all the blue from all the paintings at the museum? All the blue!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Great. Now he wants me to pick up some evil blueprints for his latest evil contraption. And as soon as he's done building it, I'll have proof! I'll call you, and you can see for yourself.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, Mom. He's evil. You don't notice about him? He has evil schemes. Normal people don't have schemes of any kind. And then there's this secret agent that always bursts in, and--

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, my dad's kind of an amateur inventor. I think I saw some books over here. (sees books cluttered with lasers on a table) Oh, here we go. Uh, we can just put his other stuff anywhere. What's the name of the book again?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) I don't usually like to get involved with this stuff, but if there's an inator, there's a self-destruct button. There's always a self-destruct button. That'll take care of it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know, Ferb. I know he's my dad and I shouldn't blame him for being busy, it's just that...he always seems to put his work ahead of me. (She sighs) I just don't know what to do.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Is on her cell phone wearing Candace's clothes) I can't believe it, Lacie. I look like a walking candy cane. I mean, how many evil scientists' daughters do you know who-- (She bears drilling from outside.) Hold on, Lacie. I can't hear myself gripe.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wha- hey! Watch where you're... Oh great, now this thing is broken, and they've got the Pizzazziu... (sighs) Look, (to Ferb) thanks for your help, but I can do this on my own, okay? (runs away with Pizzazzium locator)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, maybe I don't really have to have the one object my dad spent years to find in order to show me his affection. (pause) No, actually I do. (at Sally) Give me that, kid!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh please, you come out here jumping around with your costume, and your lame book, and it's... it's just humiliating, Dad. I'm not a little girl anymore.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Alright, hold it! Everybody just stop! (opening the animal agents like a door) Excuse me. (to Candace-2) Can I talk to my parents? Listen, Mom, Dad, come here. You guys, I'm only gonna say this once. (breathes) RUN!!!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: C'mon, Candace, there's like a million other things we can do tonight besides busting your brothers. We can do anything! Well, anything but sleep.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! This entire trip has been about your work! That's it! If you don't want to spend time with me, then I don't want to spend time with you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And yet, in spite of all that, there's my dad free to do it all over again the next day. Whoa, really effective bunch of spies there, major.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, look, this OWCA internship is something I really wanna do. And I don't think this lifestyle choice is making you happy either. Is it?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) His name is Monty, Dad. Look, if we told you the truth, neither of you would have come. Let's try and be civilized and enjoy ourselves?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I know, I know, but all I want to do is have a good time with my friends, and you just keep popping up. It's like you don't trust me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Halfway, huh? Hmm. (Ferb looks and sees a flower shop as she's talking) You mean like, maybe I should take an interest in his work? I would but, it's actually evil. I just can't... (She looks to see Ferb is gone) Ferb?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, Ferb. You certainly know how to show a girl a good time! (holds up the Pizzazium) I've gotta get this to my dad immediately. (Ferb throws the Pizzazium into the tennis ball launcher, which fires) Whoa! (the Pizzazium bounces and rolls past Doofenshmirtz, in line at the checkout counter, to the entrance of the store; Doofenshmirtz gleefully picks it up) Well, that worked.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (removing a shrimp from her hair) Yeah. Well, I suppose that could have gone worse. We like each other, right? It's not just that we enjoy messing with our dads?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You put a self-destruct button in a death chamber? I'm so out of here. This is the worst Bring-Your-Daughter-To-Work-Day ever.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks. It was good hanging with you. We should do it again sometime. Preferably without the threat of a zombie apocalypse.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You did what? I don't want them to see this! I'm a teenager. This... this is for a little girl. Don't you know me at all?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hmmm, I guess you're right. Maybe deeply depressed generational trauma could be fun? And I am curious about our culture.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So I look up, and there he is in front of the whole school... (indistinct)... finally stepping on the other team's feet as he walks.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I need a car. I can't keep riding on the back of your scooter every time I go someplace. It's totally embarrassing.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (angrily) This is what I'm talking about. You're not even listening! (starts walking towards the door, without Doofenshmirtz noticing) I'm moving out, Dad. I'm going to live at Mom's... (walks out the door) full-time. (slams the door)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, that's cool. If by cool you mean completely embarrassing me in front of the only people whose opinions matter to me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Look at this, it says that the tallest structure in Tokyo is the Tokyo Tower. And it even looks like the Eiffel Tower!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, my dad gave me permission to use his castle, and then all I had to do was call the best party planners in town.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're my punk-rock boyfriend, you're not supposed to think my dad is cool! (She walks over to Doofenshmirtz) It only matters that I think he's cool. (Kisses him on the cheek)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You're my punk-rock boyfriend! You're not supposed to think my dad is cool! (She walks over to Doofenshmirtz) It only matters that I think he's cool. (Kisses him on the cheek)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay Dad, if you want to hold your head and quiver some more, that's totally okay with me, but can I have the keys?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know. The whole star-crossed-love thing was fun and all, but I just couldn't keep lying to my dad about us.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I happen to be throwing the biggest, baddest, Halloweeniest bash ever! It's tonight, and I think you should come.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, you're totally missing the point. You spend all of your time working on your ridiculous inators and I can't—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, actually, my dad put it together... with some help from Perry the Platypus. (To Perry) Thank you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad! I just got some great lemonade from the new stand down the street. It's really sour. Do you want to--(slips on some paper; exclaims)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So I thought we could watch this foreign art film I found. Le Coeur Noir De Douleur et de la Tristesse Douce.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I'm just buyin' some snacks. Some of the girls are coming over later for a movie night. Should be cool.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (takes the note and reads it) "Congratulations, due to your upcoming 17th birthday, you are now eligible for Drusselsteinian citizenship."

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah... I was really hoping for Paris. I mean, I did drop all those hints, but I guess Tokyo is more exotic.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, time to find out where they dragged Dad off to. Guess that car will have to wait. Oh, yeah. Thanks. (kisses Ferb on the cheek and leaves; the floral background and music start up again)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Should we even be seen in the same room together? I mean, you know, our dads being sworn enemies and all?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, would you get off that? Making matching boots is normal. You with the one boot, that's what's crazy.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs and facepalms) Yes, Dad. Just, please, be on your best behavior tonight, and promise me no inators at the dinner table.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So I've got to find some way to prove to you I'm responsible. There must be an easier way to earn a car.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Uh, hey there, strange man I've never met. What brings you to our campsite? And how soon can you leave?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, have fun with that. I'm gonna go check out the ship while there's still stuff let to see on it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Mom, I'm not being dramatic. Dad builds evil contraptions every day. Wait. (Phone beeps) Let me check on something.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: This place doesn't seem so bad, Dad. From what you told me, sounds like Gimmelsthump needed a change.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Come on, Candace! Come on, come on! Get in! (they run into her bedroom and close the door) Okay, that's really wrong. Even by my dad's standards.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, so we're evil again? Hi, Perry. (to her father) I'm meeting up with some friends. Try not to blow yourself up.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Well, I'll stick around and help you figure it out. I hear OWCA is looking for a few good animals.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) Don't be ridiculous, Dad. Just find us a good spot, yeah? I'll be right back. I smell Slushy Dawg.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, it's not like they're sworn enemies who will disown us when they find out we've been dating.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Maybe you should just let me off here. At least I can start the party off with my dignity intact.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, everything you've told me about the old country is terrible. Why would you wanna go back?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It says here that the Tokyo Tower is the tallest self-supporting steel structure in the world!

Name: Vanessa

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, come on, Dad, you build them just to exact petty revenge trying to prove you're evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You do know that what he calls a "spy network" is actually just a petting zoo. With hats!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: All right, that's enough! (Scoffs) Really Perry? Really?! I expect more from you. A-And you, Dad!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You think that's bad, every time I use the microwave, Norm starts involuntarily rapping.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Nothing. It's just... Johnny, he's such a boy. I'm sick of it. No ambition, no depth...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I had to. This is a big night for me, my boyfriend's coming. Oh, here he is right now.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (yawns) Oh, hey, Perry. Dad, I just woke up from the weirdest dream. I was driving in this...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You know he'll just blow the door down if you don't open it. (opens door revealing Perry holding a bazooka) Come in, Perry. Toodles! (she leaves)

Name: Vanessa

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: A video game is more important than me? That's it! I'm done! We are so over, Johnny!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whatever. I'm headed to the park to watch Uncle Roger's speech. You wanna come with?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's the plan! I'm checking out my Queen of the Vampires costume even as we speak.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, never mind that, but Dad and Norm built an entire country on the sea. Come on!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I'm not your little girl anymore. Look at me, I'm sixteen years old! Sixteen!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm not evil. Just get in the car before they find out this is only a hair dryer.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm going to the airport and I'm flying to Paris. (Perry lands beside her) Hey, Perry. (to Doofenshmirtz) Alone if I have to!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, guys, it's such a beautiful day. I thought maybe we could put the top down?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What? Is that what you think I look lik... Wait, you made this? What size is it?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Phone beeps) Yup. He's even got his own evil jingle right on his answering machine. (Speed dial) Listen!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, so did I. But then I figured I couldn't leave you here to suffer alone.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I thought you were going to stay upstairs! I've got the snacks covered.

Name: Vanessa

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Relax, will you? I'm just looking forward to the '50s Doo Wop Hop tonight.

Name: Vanessa

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks for introducing me to the ironic enjoyment of Ducky Momo, Candace.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Now, come on. Just-Just stand up. It's okay. It's time to face your fear.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sigh) I just need some space, that's all. Ar -- are you even listening to me?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Now, what if, hear me out, you tried meeting someone in the real world?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You did, didn't you? You know what Dad, move over. I'm coming with you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? Oh, hey, Perry. I was making a sandwich. Where'd all the bread go?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I only wrote that because namedropping the Mayor would get me in.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Welcome to my castle party! (At the entrance, she is dressed in her vampire queen dress and wig; Lacie walks up to her.) Here's a mask. Lacie, wow, great costume!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: And to think I wanted to come back to school for a sense of normalcy.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So your idea of a break from evil is to steal everything on the ship?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "We"? Shouldn't you be off playing with your little platypus friend?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, you're such a drama queen. See, this... This is why we broke up!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Do you usually have coffee with your dad's sworn enemy's daughters?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. Yeah, I guess he did. Thanks, Dad. You finally got one right.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (On her cell phone) Mom, Mom, you've got to come quick. There's proof that Dad is evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Laughs) What can I say? You walk slow. So, uh, what are you doing tonight?

Name: Vanessa and Monty
Dialog: (At the same time) Cappuccino with chocolate powder on top and a ginger scone please. (Glances at each other)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I could use some downloading too. I'll go make us some tea. (starts walking away) B-R-B.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm headed over my Dad's house if you want to look for your book.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Laughs) I'm surprised your dad hasn't put some kind of spy camera on you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yes, very trying. Do you remember the last time he picked me up?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: How could I do that when I'm always on the back of your scooter?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Trying on Doofenshmirtz's boot trap) So, uh, you didn't by any chance make a left-boot trap, did you?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No. It means I am finally gonna have proof. Ha! You are busted.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: We dare you not to get your mom! (Candace has fled; to Stacy) Welp, if you can't beat 'em...

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait, so there's still a 45% chance that it won't do anything?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Definitely. Come on, Dad. Let's go play a game of Kleptocracy.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, how about go downstairs and take a bite of Perry's food?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Monty should've been here by now. (Another Scarlet Pimpernel approaches her.) Finally… wait, who are you?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, it's goths, not Visigoths. And they're punks, not goths. (Hangs up)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But, we're not gonna do...all of..."this"...every day, right?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad! Why did you pick up? You always let the machine get it!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah. Very, very nice, Dad. But, listen, I have something I—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, they have ridesharing. And cell service, thank goodness.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Join you? I don't work for him. That's my father, you dweeb.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Thanks for driving me to the Scrapyard Invasion party, Mom.

Name: Vanessa-2
Dialog: Uh, Mom, Tony Marzulo asked me out to the movies. Can I go?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Eh, I'm over it. I think it's time I tried a... (She watches Monty leave using a jet-pack. Monty looks at her and smiles before leaving.) A good guy.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Really? (Sees Derek shrieking.) Wow, cool! It looks like your cousin, Narthelliot.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Talking on her cell phone) Mom, I'm at the docks. You gotta get down here right away.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I don't know. His schemes normally aren't this successful.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad. I'm headed out to the— (sees Jeremy) Oh, a guitar player, huh?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow! This is like the coolest midday scrapyard rave ever!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'll have you know, my father is a misunderstood genius.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I have no idea. Hold that thought, this needs more milk.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No! No special treatment, because this is not happening!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, look out! Wha... (She tries to move but she's wearing Perry's boot trap, which is attached to the floor.) Oh, you have got to be kidding me.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Was one of those things "To be evil"? Because he's evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I have to call you back. (Closes cell phone) What on Earth is going on here?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, I got an internship at OWCA, so I have to move out.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: That's what you get for using a bunch of stupid pigeons.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hold it right there! (She holds up what looks like a ray of some sort) Step away from the evil scientist!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Speaking of friends, I think you have a little visitor.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (angrily) Dad, this is the problem! (Doofenshmirtz writes on the clipboard) Because of your stupid work—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what did we agree after the vegan rodeo incident?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, hold on to that thought. My dad's picking me up. (Exits car)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: There's always lots of spare parts laying around here.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? What are you doing here? This isn't your weekend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Glances back and notices Monty.) I know you. Didn't I see you flying off my dad's roof?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Let's see if we get a signal further up the mountain.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, hey, Narthelliot! We were just talking about you.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? I was just gonna... Wait. What do you mean "we"?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (Scoffs) You should try spending an hour with my dad sometime.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: All right, boys, let me hear some of that Rebel bass!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, this is a bot. Her name is literally "Robotina".

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Doofenshmirtz". It's my last name. Heinz is my Dad.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: But..it says nothing about a...giant water balloon.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah! I just saw a rat! (her phone rings) Ugh, it's my dad. (answers it) Yes, Dad?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Johnny, you've gotta come out! My dad can help you!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So, uh, do you know anything by the Scraping Fangs?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It wasn't like we were going out that long, Johnny!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Okay, we have to take a moment and think about the—

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Sure, it's a little different, but I kinda like it.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I can't believe you remembered I wanted this.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: No, it ended up here by mistake, and it's my doll.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Of course I can. I'm me. It'll be a piece of cake.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (takes the pie) Yes, I do love it and thank you, but (closes the door on him) please, Dad.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, perhaps you haven't noticed but you're evil.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What?! Dad, you have to tell us things like this!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, why are you wearing that? Aren't you immune?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Sorry, Norm. He gets hangry without his smoothie.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Look, all I'm saying is try something different.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Johnny? Er, "Creature formerly known as Johnny"?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I can't believe you brought work with you again!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, relax. It's just a bat. They just eat bugs.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Me, too! Well, my dad was also driving me nuts.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, by the way, I'm taking the last escape pod.

Dialog: Oh, good, Mom's here! Mom, where have you been?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You look great, Sir Grant. (gives him a mask) Goth dragons beware!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wow, I bet that thing must be really evil, huh?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'm here to pick up an order for Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (chuckles) Naw, I'm just messin' with you. Everyone knew. (She drives away with Ferb, leaving Phineas and Isabella alone.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad?! What are you doing here? It's dangerous!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Dad, one of your planets just stole my jacket!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, whoa, did you just say "inators"?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (flatly) Check out these gains. Thank you, Doofnasium.

Dialog: Wow! That was really kind of swashbuckle-y!

Dialog: This is not my dad's everyday weird either.

Dialog: (laughs) Buford, you look just like Queen Victoria!
